content: PyPI torch 2.15.0 metadata (primary): Linux x86_64 wheel ~539MB and requires cuda-toolkit==13.2.2, cuda-bindings, nvidia-cudnn-cu13, nvidia-cusparselt-cu13, nvidia-nccl-cu13, nvidia-nvshmem-cu13, triton (all platform_system==Linux) - multi-GB CUDA install by default on Linux; macOS arm64 ~139MB, Windows ~127MB. torch 2.15 Requires-Python >=3.11 (SIF supports 3.10 => older torch resolution there). CPU-only Linux wheels live on download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu (separate index). sentence-transformers pulls torch transitively; SIF embed extra has no torch pin.
